THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I , Gayantha Karunatilleke Minister of Lands & ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the Land described below is needed for apublic purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The alloments of below mentioned lands, depicted in AdvanceTracing No. H/BLA/RDA/2018/263 and dated 2018.06.26, preparedby the Survey General, Situated in the village of Mahaheella (F. V.P. 297) in the Minor Division of Giruwapattuwa South in theDivisional Secretary Division of Beliatta in Hambantota District inSouthern Province and bounded as follows:
